description: Change how a table looks: table_style (Tabellenformat), cell_style with cell_style_scope all|header|body|footer, column_widths_mm (one per column) or width_mm (proportional), header_rows and footer_rows (converted from existing rows; at least one body row must remain). At least one parameter. Unknown style names are not_found with the available names in the details. Returns the table summary (widths, heights, counts, table_style), cells_styled, changed, overset.

cell_style.description: Cell style (Zellenformat) by exact name; get_table lists the available ones.

cell_style_scope.description: Which rows get cell_style. Default all.

column_widths_mm.description: Column widths in mm, one per column.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

footer_rows.description: Number of footer rows (taken from the bottom rows).

header_rows.description: Number of header rows (taken from the top rows).

table_index.description: Which table of the story, in text order, 0 = first. Default 0.

table_style.description: Table style (Tabellenformat) by exact name; get_table lists the available ones.

width_mm.description: Total table width in mm, columns scaled proportionally.

name: set_table_style
title: Table style, cell style, widths
